Launch Firefly Cinema

caption-workshop is this profile's first runnable mission. The illustration is a fictional world; the application and this example can be run locally.

  1. Download the source ZIP and extract it. Open the caption-workshop folder.
  2. Install Node.js 22+ if needed. The archive contains the original README and LICENSE.
  3. On Windows, run Start.cmd. Or, from the extracted project folder, run node server.mjs and open http://127.0.0.1:8803.
  4. Run the checked example from that folder:
node examples/profile-mission/check.mjs

See examples/profile-mission/README.md for the input files, expected outcome and one useful next change. Data are synthetic.

What was verified

The example completed successfully and 10 existing project tests passed. Source snapshot and result. This establishes the checked processing behaviour; a graphical browser session was not part of this check.

Original project authors, LICENSE and repository history retain their attribution. The source download omits Git's database and Windows desktop.ini files. For a separate public project repository, use the original local repository to preserve its history.
